metadata.scenario: A man calls for the first time asking about speech therapy services for his mother who had a stroke. He asks about frequency, duration of sessions, and cost. The receptionist provides a quote for twice-weekly sessions at $95 each. He sounds hopeful and wants to start next week. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, my name is William Chen. I'm calling about speech therapy services for my mother. She had a stroke recently. I’m sorry to hear about your mother, William. I can definitely provide information on speech therapy. Great, I’d like to know how often the sessions would be and how long each one lasts. Typically, we recommend sessions twice a week, with each session lasting about 60 minutes. That sounds good. And what’s the cost for each session? The cost for each speech therapy session is $95. Okay, so that would be about $190 a week. That’s manageable. Can we start as soon as next week? Yes, we can certainly arrange that. Would you like me to check the availability for next week? Yes, please! I want to make sure we can get a good time slot. Perfect. Can I have your mother's full name and contact information to set up the sessions? Her name is Helen Chen, and my phone number is +13165554321. Thank you, William. I’ll also need to know if you’d like us to coordinate with any other healthcare providers. Yes, she’s currently seeing a neurologist. I can give you their contact info if needed. That would be helpful, thank you. I’ll make a note to reach out to them for care coordination. Sounds good. Will you be sending me any paperwork or details before we start? Yes, I’ll email you the intake forms and our service agreement. You can fill them out at your convenience. Great, I appreciate that. Is there anything else I should know about the sessions? Just to ensure she’s comfortable, we recommend a quiet space at home for the therapy sessions. That makes sense. I’ll set that up. Perfect, I’ll get this all set up and confirm the schedule with you shortly. Thank you so much, Margaret. I’m looking forward to starting this process. You’re welcome, William. We’re here to help, and we’ll be in touch soon! Have a great day! You too! Goodbye!
